name: Sentiment Slice
subtitle: Keep only the people who said what you're looking for.
summary: Takes a dataset you've already collected and keeps the rows matching a criterion you describe in plain language ("the skeptics", "asked about pricing"), plus any it could not judge, flagged as unclear, as a new dataset. It only works on datasets whose rows carry text, like repliers and quoters, so an X list or a follower dataset cannot be sliced. The original is untouched.
howToAsk: Keep only the [criterion] from my dataset
Pull out the people who asked about [topic].
get: a new dataset of the matches, with honest matched and unclear counts.
launchPrompt: Check my recent datasets, tell me which ones have what people actually wrote, then make a new dataset from the best fit keeping only the people who [your criterion].
